name: Storyfold
milestone: Record studio0.1.9 installed: direct sequence preview
message: Installed0.1.9 plays source cuts/audio/cards/inserts directly for Linux Preview without first exporting or saving a version.192 ordinary tests, strict lint, native controls and package/install checks pass. Explicit Export retains rendering progress. Physical camera latency, audible quality, OBSBOT connection and app unification remain separate.

tasks.title: Make the build visible
tasks.acceptance: Architecture and schema committed; progress, task edits, source review and undo available in Catalyst.

tasks.title: Edit an interview by sentences
tasks.acceptance: Topic folders, sentence selection, live groups, reorder, trims, camera selection, L-cuts, skip, undo and persisted autosave work.

tasks.title: Process and export real media
tasks.acceptance: Upload and timed transcript or word-timestamp transcription; ffmpeg proxies, peaks and MP4; SRT, EDL and FCPXML downloads.

tasks.title: Verify the complete local flow
tasks.acceptance: Typecheck, lint, unit and integration tests, browser acceptance and probed ffmpeg render pass.

tasks.title: Validate your sample interview
tasks.acceptance: 20-sentence accuracy/timing audit, camera clap alignment and NLE import checked using the supplied real interview.

tasks.title: Package the desktop app
tasks.acceptance: Windows and Ubuntu installers and CI; native folder picker and keychain support.

tasks.title: Connect publishing and site care
tasks.acceptance: Configured deployment, preflight, rollback, host adapters, CLI/MCP and backups verified.

tasks.title: Apply the verified Doberman compatibility repair
tasks.acceptance: Approved repair applied with backup; installed and original hashes match the tested artifacts. Native edits pass while protected paths remain blocked. Approval UI remains unavailable for separate sensitive actions.

tasks.title: Harden the production runtime
tasks.acceptance: Compiled server, authenticated hosted mode, durable jobs, bounded media resources, project backup/restore and security regression tests.

tasks.title: Finish media and export correctness
tasks.acceptance: Long interviews batch correctly, sync uncertainty is explicit, crossfades preserve timing and interchange exports have structural validation.

tasks.title: Make preview follow the actual media clock
tasks.acceptance: Buffering pauses the story clock; cuts seek accurately and cached video slots preload the following clip; 20-edit undo and trim preview verified.

tasks.title: Use Claude for topic folders
tasks.acceptance: Private key accepted; Claude topic requests and validation are wired into the app. Live application grouping passed with 612 generated sentences, complete assignments and preserved timing. Full private-interview review remains separate.

tasks.title: Group interviews beyond 400 sentences
tasks.acceptance: Bounded requests share one folder vocabulary, cover every sentence, report batch progress and preserve speech timing. Retry and failure checks pass; live Claude grouping of 612 generated sentences succeeds. Saved projects can resume using cached transcription.

tasks.title: Transcribe video automatically with Whisper
tasks.acceptance: Local Whisper installed and exercised on speech, video-only upload creates word timestamps and sentence clips, optional transcript import remains available, and UI/backend tests pass.

tasks.title: Migrate Storyfold to Rust
tasks.acceptance: Rust-native editor and runtime preserve saved projects, automatic Whisper, Claude long-interview grouping, edits, playback/export timing and build controls. Compile, lint, unit, integration and native smoke checks pass before changing the launcher.

tasks.title: Record takes in a native studio
tasks.acceptance: Explicit camera/mic recording; horizontal/vertical preview; hold/tap takes; saved clip bin and sequence edits; manual timed overlays in MP4; handoff to existing Whisper/editor. Native and generated-media checks pass.

tasks.title: Import and publish YouTube clips
tasks.acceptance: Validated URL/range imports become local takes. Explicit Google connection and reviewed resumable upload default to Private. Progress, cancel/retry, secure tokens and meaningful checks; no automated real publishing.

tasks.title: Detect connected cameras and hotplug changes
tasks.acceptance: Connected capture-capable cameras appear; metadata nodes are excluded; automatic refresh preserves camera selection, Microphone Off and unsaved drafts; release verified without starting physical recording.

tasks.title: Improve live recording quality
tasks.acceptance: Supported HD camera mode, continuous 720p30 preview, new sources and MP4 exports at 1080p30, generated and native verification.

tasks.title: Make sequence preview and export clear
tasks.acceptance: Visible Preview sequence and Export MP4 controls work before first render and after edits, automatically saving and preparing the current sequence.

tasks.title: Apply the new Record section specification
tasks.acceptance: Keep Storyfold branding; add the specified egui/eframe foundation and video-core to Catalyst Solo, preserve its code paths, record actual validation. Record overlay AI uses local models with no paid fallback.

tasks.title: Build recording timeline and safe project core
tasks.acceptance: Clip-relative cue invariants, move/split/trim/remove/restore,100-snapshot undo, exact save/load and atomic crash safety; local Git only.

tasks.title: Connect the native studio timeline
tasks.acceptance: Ordered clips, drag/keyboard tools, both-end frame/second trim, Removed, playhead, undo/redo and shape switch.

tasks.title: Keep camera capture continuous between clips
tasks.acceptance: One FFmpeg sidecar per Studio session; one-second buffer segments, raw RGBA preview, hold/tap intervals, protected pruning, lost-device recovery and generated timing checks.

tasks.title: Render matching native overlay frames
tasks.acceptance: Six overlay types,nine slots and shared tiny-skia/cosmic-text RGBA rendering for preview and exports.

tasks.title: Build reviewed overlays with local AI
tasks.acceptance: Real search and screenshots, dropped images, strict proposals, exact-text review/apply, HTML export, usage; local model only, no paid fallback.
tasks.description: Local Qwen review, real public search and Chrome capture, OCR-exact strict proposals, approval/edit/reject, HTML and token counts implemented. Core live tests2/2 and actual egui review-button roundtrip passed on generated evidence; no paid fallback.

tasks.title: Add photo and video zoom inserts
tasks.acceptance: Start/end boxes,100–250% zoom, duration/easing/placement, preview/export matching at0,2.5,5seconds.
tasks.description: Photo/video import, start/end drag/resize zoom, full/beside/opaque-camera-in-front layouts implemented.36 exact scene comparisons and12 encoded samples at0/2.5/5s passed. Measured compositor36.1ms mean/39.5ms p95 still misses30fps; hardware acceptance remains.

tasks.title: Finish native sequence export
tasks.acceptance: 1080p horizontal/vertical H264/AAC with overlays, actual progress/cancel and Shorts notice.

tasks.title: Move publishing into native studio
tasks.acceptance: Keychain credentials, Google client setup/consent, PKCE/resumable upload, reviewed Unlisted default; no upload without explicit action.
tasks.description: Native keychain/PKCE/resumable upload, public clip importer and Project → YouTube panel integrated. All17 protocol and7 panel tests pass; real Google client/consent, keychain and publishing acceptance remain.

tasks.title: Package and validate the native studio
tasks.acceptance: Ubuntu deb/icon/integration, fresh install acceptance; report Windows/hardware checks actually performed.

tasks.title: Start fresh and list saved projects
tasks.acceptance: Startup fresh; Projects lists interviews/recordings; explicit Open and New preserve drafts and all saved media.

tasks.title: Show export loading and real progress
tasks.acceptance: Immediate loading state, FFmpeg stage/time progress, final MP4 write progress and errors are visible.

tasks.title: Restore visible sequence playback and expanded preview
tasks.acceptance: Completed sequence displays video; loading/errors are explicit; expanded view and Escape preserve playback.
